page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs paired with 16.0 GB of memory. This yields a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, adhering to standard compute-focused instance profiles.

The server does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, relying entirely on remote network-attached volumes for persistence. Networking capabilities provide a baseline throughput of 3 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

Given its dedicated resource isolation and 1:2 memory ratio, ecs.c6t.2xlarge presents a compute-centric design suitable for multi-threaded workloads where processing efficiency matters more than extensive memory caching. It is appropriate for compute-heavy batch processing, web application serving, CI/CD runners, and distributed worker nodes that utilize remote block storage.
